items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: they had a corner called Mogul's Corner, right there, kind of a, uh, uh, uh, uh, Clara, Clara and uh, Cypress

ctx.x: Yeah, that's, well, it was pretty bad a long time ago. It was pretty bad a long time ago. It was so quiet, I tell you. It was, they had some roughnecks around there, yes sir. The fellas was tough around there, policemen, you couldn't hardly get a policeman to go back there if something was happening. The detail of police, and that time unit, you'd have to beat police, you see, on the beat. The fellas used to ride a horse, police on a horse.
